datasets.help: The row with the category column, the optional value column and the optional group column, each column described individually under keys. The category column is required for a chart. To clear, set one empty row ([{ x: null, y: null, g: null }]); [] is rejected.

x.label: X
x.title: Category column (X axis)
x.help: The category column (slot x); its values become the bars. Required, empty until one is chosen.

y.label: Y
y.title: Value column (numeric, optional)
y.help: The value column (slot y), numeric and optional; without it each bar counts the rows of its category. Empty until one is chosen.

g.label: G
g.title: Grouping (optional)
g.help: The group column (slot g), optional; it splits each category into groups. Empty until one is chosen.

aggregation.help: How the values of the value column are combined per bar: mean or sum. Takes effect only with a value column (slot y); without it each bar counts the rows of its category.

stacked.help: Whether the groups of a bar are stacked on top of each other (on) or placed side by side (off). Takes effect only with a group column (slot g).

stats.help: The bar values, each figure described individually under keys; null while there is no data (no category column, no values or a chosen column not readable).

activeParams.help: The fields that take effect in the current state: aggregation only with a value column (slot y) set, stacked only with a group column (slot g) set.

activeColumnSlots.help: The slot keys a row of the datasets carries: x, y, g.

chartData.help: The categories and the series (name, value per category, colour) from the chosen columns, as the chart draws them; without a group column exactly one series. Empty while there is no data.

BarStats.categories: The categories of the X column in bar order; the table shows them in the Category column.
BarStats.groups: Per group the values of all categories. Without a group column there is exactly one group, named after the value column, or after the category column without one.
BarStats.total: The sum of all values; the table shows it in the last row. It exists only for frequencies, that is without a value column; with a value column the field is empty.

BarGroup.name: The name of the group; the table shows it in the Group column, which appears only with a group column.
BarGroup.values: The value per category in category order: without a value column the number of rows, otherwise the mean or sum of the value column. If the group has no rows in a category, it shows 0 there. The table column changes its header with the aggregation (Count, Mean, Sum).
